title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released by BAI
indian_angle: This update details the decisions made by the junior selection committee, directly impacting the future of young Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India released the minutes from its recent Junior Selection Committee meeting, outlining key decisions for upcoming junior events and player selections.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Welfare
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures Indian players have a formal voice in the governance and development of badminton in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for player representation and addressing their concerns.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, a major international event.
summary: India's junior badminton squad has commenced its national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organises Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This initiative by BAI aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly benefiting player development at all levels.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14th to 23rd.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations will govern the upcoming Inter State Team Championships, a key domestic tournament for Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing rules and procedures for the national event.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The adoption of the 3x15 scoring system will significantly change how domestic junior ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
summary: BAI has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
